# Time To Schedule

The number of working days from the moment a candidate is shortlisted in Hireloom to the moment their first interview is booked. We report the median, not the mean, because a few vacancies left open over holidays drag the mean up.

## Why this measure

It is the part of hiring that coordinators and managers control, unlike time to hire, which depends on candidates' notice periods and checks. It is also what candidates feel first: in 2025 about 6% of shortlisted candidates withdrew before being booked when it took four days or more ([[interview-scheduling-baseline-2025]]).

## Values

- Baseline (October 2024 to February 2025): 4.2 working days.
- After self-scheduling (June to July 2025): 1.6 ([[interview-scheduling-overhaul-closure-report]]).
- 2026: between 1.5 and 1.8 each month, 1.7 in peak.

## How it is calculated

Hireloom report "Scheduling times", status change to Shortlisted to first interview booking timestamp, weekends and public holidays excluded. Interviews booked outside Hireloom are missing.

## Caveat

A short time to schedule is not good if interviews are then booked two weeks out. We also watch "booked to interview date", which has stayed around 3 working days.
